niche: first-pass human verification of OCR-captured insurance-claim key fields in a BPO capture centre's pooled day and night queues: which client streams get second-pass verification in the month a typed-form client joins the day queue and a handwritten motor stream moves to nights
answer: Put five streams on second-pass verification for November, Brightmoor Comp's first reports (BMC-FROI), Wattlebird's extras claims (WBH-EXTR), Coolabah's income protection claims (CIP-IPCL), Whinfell's pet claims (WPC-PETC) and Hollings & Pryce's typed claims (HPY-TYPD), and leave the other six off.

driver: A unit's forward residual depends on a detection step whose hit rate is not a fixed property of the detector, the unit or the shift but falls as targets become rarer in the shared pool the detector works, so a near-clean source joining the pool lowers detection on every other unit's items and a target-rich unit leaving one pool for another raises detection there; every route that carries each unit's measured hit rate forward, stratified by unit, shift, detector or tenure, or ties detection to the unit's own target share, clears units that will breach and keeps units that will not.
driver_concrete: Rebuild each shift-day pool's key-field OCR error rate from the blind re-key audit and the first-pass edit log, estimate first-pass detection against it within verifier and field type (signal detection's low-prevalence effect: verifiers miss more as errors in the queue they work become rarer), the one model the closed quarter's shift-days leave standing (every attribute-only model's night and Saturday terms are that rate's gaps), and apply it to the November plan, where the motor claims leaving for nights and Hollings & Pryce's typed claims at about 0.6 per cent cut the day pool from about 4.3 to about 1.9 per cent and the motor claims lift the night pool from about 2.5 to about 5.0 per cent.
stump: A competent solver dedupes the timeout re-verifications, measures each stream's first-pass misses from the blind re-key audit, models detection on verifier, stream, field type, tenure, shift, time on shift, workload and day of week, takes the best-fitting of those models on a clean month-by-month back-test, and applies it to the November plan (the motor claims on nights, Hollings & Pryce on days, the roster moves), keeping Kessington's two streams, Northgate, Brightmoor, Harbison and the motor claims on second pass and the day streams off; the step that lands it there is treating detection as a property of the verifier, stream, shift or day when it rises and falls with the error rate of the shift's whole pool, which the plan cuts on the day queue (about 4.3 to 1.9 per cent) and raises on the night queue (about 2.5 to 5.0).
analyst_test: A strong analyst who sessionises the log, dedupes the timeout re-verifications, resolves reissued verifier IDs, reads QCP-04 and every quality schedule correctly, and models first-pass detection on every visible attribute (verifier, stream, field type, tenure, shift, time on shift, workload, day of week), taking the best-fitting of them on a clean month-by-month back-test, still keeps the four night streams and the motor claims on second pass and leaves the day streams and Hollings & Pryce off, because detection follows the error rate of the pool each verifier works, which no row carries and the November plan lowers on days and raises on nights.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each stream's first-pass residual next month, which human reliability assessment estimates as a verification task's non-detection probability under the conditions it will run in, and the condition that moves is target prevalence (signal detection's low-prevalence effect: observers shift their criterion and miss more when targets are rare, so detection measured in one pool does not travel to a pool with a different error rate); a generalist's corrections (stratify by stream, shift, verifier or tenure, reweight to the new mix, add controls for time on shift, workload and day of week) treat detection as a fixed property of an attribute and never construct the pool's error rate; with an automated validation rule in place of the verifiers there is no criterion shift and the task stops reading the same.

differentiation.task33: task33 projects a breach's forward yield, which stops at a filed intervention recovered by back-testing closed actions; here nothing is back-tested or filed: a human detector's hit rate moves with the target prevalence of the pool it works, and the forward pool's prevalence is set by the operating plan
differentiation.task114: task114's demand exists only when two parties share a site on a day, so site records add up short; here every record is exact and the hit rate of a human verification step depends on the error prevalence of the shared queue, which a new near-clean source dilutes
differentiation.task46: task46 reconstructs a cumulative service-exposure clock from a movement log for a wear rate; here there is no clock or accumulation: detection responds to the prevalence of targets in the pool at the time, a perceptual criterion shift that reverses when the pool's mix reverses

lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-11 and re-rooted: solver rounds 1 and 2 landed the call (proxy 80.7 and 79.7), the solver holding the comparison pool to the CRM engagement segment and then to phones that can take 7.0; hardening loop 2 found on paper no rung that deepens the analysis away from the comparison pool, plants nothing and is forced to one flag set (DESIGN_NOTE.md, Hardening loop 2, on paper); the world was not kept because its organisation family (hospital_or_health_provider) repeats task181
lineage.driver: A staggered switch reaches heavy users first and only reaches units whose equipment meets its minimum, so its effect is read against units of the same usage band that have not switched yet; but inside each band that pool fills week by week with units that never can switch, whose own seasonal trend runs harder than the switched units' would have, so a counterfactual taken within the band alone books part of their trend as the switch's doing, and only a pool held to units able to switch, inside the band, reads the switch alone, which moves units across the tolerance in both directions.
lineage.driver_concrete: The 7.0 build swaps the analytics SDK, reaches frequent patients first through the update prompt at sign-in, and needs iOS 16 or Android 10, so the 13 per cent of patients on older phones stay on 6.8; inside every engagement segment the patients still on 6.8 in a settled week are more and more those older handsets, whose appointment, change-request, results and notification traffic climbs 10 to 21 points faster into the winter than other patients' of the same segment. Differenced within segment alone the new SDK looks to lose appointment change requests and notification opens it does not lose and to leave appointment views and test result views flat when they rise five per cent; held within segment and to phones that can take 7.0, five series break: appointment views, test result views, clinic letter views, waiting list checks and digital check-ins.
lineage.stump: A competent solver maps each patient's handover week and carries each switched patient's reference level by the movement of patients still on 6.8 in the same CRM engagement segment, confirmed by a never-switched control and a group-rate index; inside every segment that pool fills week by week with phones below 7.0's minimum (iOS 16, Android 10), whose winter appointment, change-request, results and notification traffic climbs 10 to 21 points faster, so it flags appointment change requests (-6.0) and notification opens (-4.0) and clears appointment views (+1.0) and test result views (+0.5); held within segment and to phones that can take 7.0, the flags are appointment views, test result views, clinic letter views, waiting list checks and digital check-ins.
lineage.answer: Flag five series in the Q4 return, appointment views, test result views, clinic letter views, waiting list checks and digital check-ins, and notify the other five as continuous.

lineage.driver: A switch reaches heavy users first, so its effect has to be read against users who have not switched yet in the same weeks, but those users are a lighter mix whose seasonal trend runs harder than the switched users' own; taking the whole not-yet-switched pool as the counterfactual books part of the season as the switch's doing, and only a counterfactual built within each usage band, or reweighted to the switched users' band mix, reads the switch alone, which moves units across the tolerance in both directions.

notes: Pattern A decisive (gap time): each stream's measured Q3 residual is a correct statement about Q3's pools, and the November plan moves both pools' error rates outside anything a Q3 month showed (inside the range Q3's shift-days span), so the forward residual has to be built from detection as a function of the pool's rate; G14 supports (detection conditioned on a property of the shift-day pool, a different entity from the stream), G13 supports (retrospective actuals against a prospective month), G17 supports (separating the pool's rate from shift, day of week, tenure and workload). Gate method_or_model_selection: the design forces the method (determinism-check section 1, form 1): QCP-04 files the estimand (4.1), the rule (4.2) and the records with one method for every stream (4.3), never a method or a selection criterion, and the closed quarter's shift-days rule out every attribute-only model (within each queue the misses move with the shift-day pool's error rate, and the night and Saturday terms are its gaps). Strategy causal_design for interference: one client's volume changes other clients' residuals through the shared verifier pool; not forecast_method_backtest: nothing filed selects a method, the textbook monthly back-test is clean on every attribute model, and what decides is constructing the interference channel. Subdomain human-reliability-assessment: the quantity is a verification task's human error probability under next month's conditions; the taxonomy lists the task type under Forecasting, and the build keeps Data Quality Monitoring because the object is the capture pipeline's delivered accuracy and the call is which streams its second verification control covers. validated_decoy false: no certified figure set ships, and the closed record refutes fixed detection at the shift grain. calibration_form none: the blind re-key audit is the primary measurement, not a calibration organ, and no back-test is filed.
